description: Use when the user asks which Chinese factories can make a part, which suppliers offer a process (CNC machining, injection molding, 3D printing, sheet metal, die casting, etc.), or wants suppliers filtered by region, certification or material. Returns only public L0 profile fields and canonical source URLs. Results are ranked by a public profile-completeness quality_score; no grid, price or payment fields are read.

capability_id.description: Exact capability row id, e.g. cnc-machining/03.

certification.description: Certification name, issuer or number substring.

process.description: Process/capability id to match primary profile or recent work.

region.description: Province or city substring, e.g. Guangdong or Shenzhen.

tolerance_max_mm.description: Only return suppliers whose declared tolerance is at or below this value in mm.

name: search_suppliers
